text.p: Aluminium foil and sheet maker Reynolds Philippines Corp said on Monday its 1997 net forecast of 301 million pesos had included effects of price cuts due to a tariff cut on aluminium product imports.

The firm had reduced prices of its products in the fourth quarter of 1996 in anticipation of the cut in tariffs on aluminium foil, plates, sheets, strips and coils to 10 percent from 20 at the start of 1997, Jorge Navarra, chief financial officer of Reynolds told Reuters.
The firm reported a net income of 107 million pesos in 1996.
Reynolds said it suffered a substantial drop in volume sales in the last quarter of 1996 as buyers held orders in anticipation of the tariff cut this year.
Reynolds reported a 33.09 million pesos net income in the first quarter of the year.
"The first quarter is historically a slow period for Reynolds. The bulk of our earnings come in the fourth quarter," Navarra said.
